executive_summary.problem_statement: Task 7.7.2B demonstrated that the existing production validator (scripts/materialize_stage6m_cohort3_audio.py::validate_audio_file) enforces a duration shortfall tolerance (MAX_MP3_PADDING_FRAMES = 1152) against a duration estimate declared by soundfile / libmpg123. Because 100% of Mozilla Common Voice 27.0 recordings lack Xing/Info gapless metadata, libmpg123 computes declared frames from total file size. Non-audio container bytes (ID3v2 tags) inflate this estimate by Delta_tag = floor((A+T)*1152/bpf) - floor(A*1152/bpf) sample frames, causing 130 structurally intact recordings with error-free PCM decoding to exceed the threshold and suffer immediate destructive unlinking during archive extraction.
executive_summary.core_architectural_proposal: Task 7.7.3E proposes a decoupled two-layer validation and admission architecture coupled with an atomic, non-destructive staging materialization pipeline. Physical bitstream decodability (Layer 1) is strictly separated from research cohort admission (Layer 2). Classification is decoupled across 5 separate classification dimensions (Physical Structure, PCM Decode, Metadata Consistency, Origin Completeness, and Admission Decision). Destructive unlinking is completely eliminated in favor of diagnostic quarantine partitioning.
executive_summary.claim_b_governance_reality: Crucially, the full-cohort audit revealed that zero authoritative original-duration references exist across the entire 18,975-recording population (0 / 18,975). If Claim B (original-source unshortened status) is made a mandatory prerequisite for confirmatory admission, exactly 0 recordings qualify. The proposal presents Policy 1 (Mandatory Claim B), Policy 2A (Pure Claim A Physical Admission), and Policy 2B (Decoupled Physical Validation with Estimation Discrepancy Screen) as explicit Project Lead decisions without unilaterally selecting any policy.

power_provenance_summary.summary: Historical power simulation results at N_g = 220 are formally reconciled across three distinct milestones with exact Clopper-Pearson bounds:
power_provenance_summary.result_a: Result A: Task 5 Exploratory Screening (94.65% power, 2,000 trials, B=2,000 bootstrap; One-Sided 95% LCB = 93.747416%, Two-Sided 95% CI: [93.571456%, 95.595129%]; superseded coarse sweep).
power_provenance_summary.result_b: Result B: Task 5 Uncalibrated Confirmation (95.35% power, 10,000 trials, B=20,000 bootstrap; One-Sided 95% LCB = 94.988733%, Two-Sided 95% CI: [94.918893%, 95.754440%]; uncalibrated model with Delta_D = -2.1733 pp overshoot; superseded full-depth confirmation).
power_provenance_summary.result_c: Result C: Task 6.3 Calibrated Primary Confirmation (90.58% power, 10,000 trials, B=20,000 bootstrap; One-Sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LCB = 90.085739% >= 90.0000%; Two-Sided 95% CI: [89.990601%, 91.145641%]; strictly calibrated quadrature; approved Section 14.7 design result).
power_provenance_summary.governance_note: Under protocol convention, the one-sided LCB governs; the historical two-sided 95% CI lower endpoint of 89.990601% does not pass 90.0% on its own. The result remains conditional on registered data-generating treatment effect assumptions (Delta_D = -2.0 pp, Delta_A = Delta_B = -3.5 pp).

executive_summary.role_separation_governance: Admitting all 18,975 files as dataset assets (under Policy 2A) does NOT mean all 1,265 speakers participate in the confirmatory evaluation estimand. The 1,100 evaluation speakers, 100 gate-reference speakers, and 65 Australian reserve speakers strictly retain their distinct, pre-registered roles: evaluation speakers test confirmatory hypotheses; gate-reference speakers calibrate adaptation gating; reserve speakers remain unexposed.
executive_summary.archive_replay_and_durability_reality: Sequential .tar.gz archives cannot be seek-skipped in O(1). Resuming from byte 0 requires continuous decompression, TAR scanning, and in-memory hashing of previously committed members to verify integrity (no repeated disk writes or audio decoding occur, but decompression, TAR scanning, and hashing do occur; zero validation overhead is retracted). For crash durability, Windows promotion specifies MoveFileExW omitting MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING for atomic no-clobber, and MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH where write-through durability is required. Directory metadata flush failures (fsync) transition the transaction to state DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN without deleting either copy, reconciling destination and journal by hash on restart. A single serialized journal writer records unique transaction IDs (tx_id).

current_production_audit.control_flow: Archive extraction writes directly to final destination audio_dir/{recording_id}.mp3, invokes validate_audio_file, and if validation returns False, immediately executes dest_file.unlink(missing_ok=True) at line 1049.
architectural_defects: Coupling bitstream decodability with container estimation heuristics.
Destructive unlinking of failed files without quarantine preservation.
Lack of intermediate staging directory and transactional journal.
Direct in-place extraction to production destinations.

decoupled_classification_model.description: Decoupled 5-dimensional classification model eliminating conflation between physical decodability and research eligibility.

core_principles: Zero Destructive Unlinking: Never delete the only acquired physical copy of a recording.
Staging Isolation: All extractions occur in temporary staging directories on the same filesystem.
Atomic Promotion: Staging files are promoted to destination directories via atomic same-volume operations.
Transactional WAL: Every file state transition is journaled before promotion.

pipeline_stages.name: Streaming Archive Ingest
pipeline_stages.invariant: Never write directly to production directories.

pipeline_stages.name: Container & Size Sanitization
pipeline_stages.invariant: Empty files diverted to quarantine as FAIL_EMPTY_FILE.

pipeline_stages.name: Diagnostic Parsing & PCM Decoding
pipeline_stages.action: Run MPEG frame parser and full SoundFile PCM decode.
pipeline_stages.invariant: No file deletion regardless of decoder outcome.

pipeline_stages.name: Five-Dimensional Classification
pipeline_stages.action: Assign 5 classification states and determine quarantine destination.
pipeline_stages.invariant: State assignment recorded in memory structure.

pipeline_stages.name: Pre-Promotion WAL Journal Append
pipeline_stages.action: Write PREPARED record with tx_id to .staging/wal_journal.jsonl and flush.
pipeline_stages.invariant: WAL write precedes any promotion action.

pipeline_stages.name: Same-Volume Atomic Promotion
pipeline_stages.action: Execute MoveFileExW (Windows) or hardlink+unlink (POSIX) to final destination.
pipeline_stages.invariant: Atomic move; destination never clobbered or overwritten.

pipeline_stages.name: Directory Metadata Flush & Verification
pipeline_stages.action: Call fsync on destination directory. On failure, transition to DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN.
pipeline_stages.invariant: Preserve both staging and destination if flush fails.

pipeline_stages.name: Post-Promotion WAL Commit & Ledger Projection
pipeline_stages.action: Write COMMITTED record to WAL; idempotently append row to CSV ledger.
pipeline_stages.invariant: CSV ledgers are reproducible projections of authoritative WAL.

resilience_specifications.archive_replay_complexity: In a sequential .tar.gz archive, compressed bytes form a continuous DEFLATE bitstream without random-access sync points. On restart from byte 0: the client sequentially replays decompression and TAR member scanning. To verify previously committed members against recorded ledger hashes, their decompressed payload must still be streamed and hashed in memory. Thus: NO REPEATED DISK WRITES and NO REPEATED AUDIO DECODING occur for committed members, but DECOMPRESSION, TAR SCANNING, and IN-MEMORY HASH COMPUTATION DO OCCUR. True O(1) random-access requires an external index. The claim of zero validation overhead is formally retracted.
resilience_specifications.windows_promotion_flags: On Windows, atomic no-clobber promotion must use MoveFileExW with flag 0 (omitting MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING), which fails atomically with ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS if the target exists. Where write-through durability is required, the implementation must additionally specify MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH. The implementation specification explicitly distinguishes no-replace behavior from write-through durability.
resilience_specifications.durability_uncertain_recovery_state: In Scenario 20 (filesystem metadata flush failure): if promotion succeeds (destination link exists) but directory metadata fsync fails, promotion cannot simply be 'aborted and staged file retained' because the destination link already exists on disk. The pipeline transitions the recording to state DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN: 1. Retain both staging and destination copies without unlinking either. 2. Write a DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN record to the WAL journal with unique tx_id. 3. Stop further materialization. 4. On restart, the reconciliation sweep verifies destination file existence and SHA-256 against staging; if identical, completes    ledger write and removes redundant staging link. Zero acquired copies are deleted.
resilience_specifications.wal_transaction_architecture: The Write-Ahead Log (.staging/wal_journal.jsonl) establishes a unique transaction/event ID (tx_id = uuid4 or monotonic counter) with a single serialized journal writer. Each entry records: tx_id, timestamp, recording_id, attempt_id, staging_path, target_path, sha256, status. Ledger writes must be replayable without duplicate rows. The WAL is the authoritative recovery record, with the CSV ledgers treated as reproducible, idempotent projections. On startup, torn or partial final lines are discarded; uncommitted PREPARED records inspect destination existence and reconcile idempotently.
resilience_specifications.preservation_of_acquired_copies: Zero unlinking strictly means NEVER DELETING THE ONLY ACQUIRED COPY of an audio recording. Removing a redundant staging hard-link after verified, fsynced destination creation does not violate evidence preservation.
resilience_specifications.incomplete_attempts_preservation: If extraction is interrupted by process crash or network drop, the incomplete .part file is preserved in .staging/interrupted/{rec_id}_{attempt_id}.part with its partial byte count and partial SHA-256 logged. On restart, retries allocate a new attempt ID without deleting prior attempts.
resilience_specifications.duplicate_archive_members: If the same recording ID appears multiple times: compute SHA-256 of new member. If identical to existing record, log DUPLICATE_SKIPPED and preserve staging copy. If conflicting, move to collision quarantine.
resilience_specifications.zero_byte_members: Zero-byte members are detected at Stage 2, moved to quarantine as FAIL_EMPTY_FILE, and never admitted.
resilience_specifications.disk_exhaustion: Pre-flight capacity check verifies free disk space exceeds uncompressed cohort estimate plus 20% safety margin.

strategies.name: Strategy A: Existing libsndfile Heuristic
strategies.formulation: Threshold check: sf.info declared frames - sf.read PCM frames <= 1152 samples.
strategies.evidence_required: soundfile declared frames and decoded frames.
strategies.potential_false_rejections: 130 recordings rejected solely due to ID3v2 tag padding.
strategies.potential_false_acceptances: Misses upstream whole-frame truncation in 100% of accepted files.
strategies.what_it_detects: Large discrepancy between container file size and decoded PCM frames.
strategies.what_it_misses: Physical MPEG bitstream validity; tag inflation offset; upstream truncation.
strategies.fail_closed_posture: Destructively unlinks on fail; fails open to upstream truncation.
strategies.assessment: DEFECTIVE: Conflates container tags with corruption; causes destructive unlinking.

strategies.name: Strategy B: Pure Decoded PCM Verification
strategies.formulation: Verify soundfile / libmpg123 decodes without error and yields non-zero samples.
strategies.potential_false_acceptances: Admits truncated files if decoder gracefully terminates.
strategies.what_it_detects: Fatal bitstream corruption preventing PCM decoding.
strategies.what_it_misses: Truncated final frames, header-decoder frame count mismatches, upstream truncation.
strategies.fail_closed_posture: Permissive; relies entirely on decoder resilience.
strategies.assessment: INSUFFICIENT: Blind to physical framing and partial final frame truncation.

strategies.name: Strategy C: Metadata-Aware Tag Shortfall Correction
strategies.formulation: Calculate Delta_tag = floor((A+T)*1152/bpf) - floor(A*1152/bpf); verify shortfall <= Delta_tag + 1152.
strategies.evidence_required: ID3v2 header tag size + soundfile info + PCM frames.
strategies.potential_false_acceptances: Admits files where upstream truncation happens to match tag size.
strategies.what_it_detects: Container-induced estimation discrepancy; confirms tag accounts for shortfall.
strategies.what_it_misses: Does not verify physical frame synchronization or EOF completeness.
strategies.complexity: Moderate (requires ID3v2 tag parser and BPF lookup).
strategies.assessment: DIAGNOSTIC CANDIDATE: Explains discrepancy, but preserves heuristic framework.

strategies.name: Strategy D: Multi-Evidence Decoupled Architecture
strategies.formulation: Independent verification of physical frames, PCM decoding, metadata, and origin completeness.
strategies.evidence_required: Physical bitstream parser + PCM decoder + metadata parser + external master reference.
strategies.potential_false_rejections: 0 recordings rejected for container tag padding.
strategies.potential_false_acceptances: 0 physical false acceptances; origin completeness explicitly unverified.
strategies.what_it_detects: Physical frame truncation, sync loss, decoder aborts, tag inflation, metadata anomalies.
strategies.what_it_misses: Upstream whole-frame truncation cannot be detected without external master (governed by Claim B).
strategies.fail_closed_posture: Strict fail-closed: defective frames quarantined; intact frames admitted with explicit provenance.
strategies.complexity: High (multi-layer parser, staging pipeline, WAL journal).
strategies.assessment: RECOMMENDED RESEARCH SPECIFICATION: Pure separation of physics and protocol.

result_c_calibrated_confirmation.label: Task 6.3 Calibrated Primary-Model Confirmation
result_c_calibrated_confirmation.task: Stage 6M Task 6.3 (Primary Model Power Consistency Audit)
result_c_calibrated_confirmation.exact_clopper_pearson_reconciliation_not: The standard exact Clopper-Pearson calculation for 9,058 successes in 10,000 trials gives one-sided 95% LCB = 90.085739% and two-sided 95% CI = [89.990601%, 91.145641%], perfectly consistent with stage6m_v1_5_mc_acceptance_rule_audit.json. The previous upper endpoint report of 91.146603% is corrected to the standard exact value 91.145641%.
result_c_calibrated_confirmation.generating_model: Exact nested-clipping quadrature calibration strictly targeting Delta_D = -2.0000 pp and Delta_A = Delta_B = -3.5 pp
result_c_calibrated_confirmation.treatment_effect_profile: Strictly calibrated: Delta_D = -2.0000 pp, Delta_A = Delta_B = -3.5 pp (0.0000 pp drift)
result_c_calibrated_confirmation.provenance_description: Task 6.3 calibrated-model confirmation evaluated at 10,000 outer trials and B=20,000 bootstrap replicates strictly targeting the pre-registered treatment effect (Delta_D = -2.0000 pp, Delta_A = Delta_B = -3.5 pp). Formally confirmed 90.58% joint power (9,058 / 10,000 trials). Exact One-Sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LCB is 90.085739% (>= 90.0000% -> PASS by +0.0857 pp / +8 trials). Exact two-sided 95% CI is [89.990601%, 91.145641%]. Under the protocol's one-sided LCB convention, the design passes; the two-sided lower endpoint (89.990601%, shortfall -0.0094 pp) does not pass the 90% criterion on its own. Governing result for approved Section 14.7 primary design.

attribution_rules: Rule 1: Result A (94.65%) must strictly be labeled exploratory screening (2,000 trials, B=2,000 bootstrap replicates, one-sided 95% LCB = 93.747416%, two-sided 95% CI: [93.571456%, 95.595129%]).

Rule 2: Result B (95.35%) must strictly be labeled full-depth uncalibrated confirmation (10,000 trials, B=20,000 replicates, one-sided 95% LCB = 94.988733%, two-sided 95% CI: [94.918893%, 95.754440%]).
Rule 3: Result C (90.58%) must strictly be labeled Task 6.3 calibrated confirmation (10,000 trials, B=20,000 replicates, one-sided 95% LCB = 90.085739%, two-sided 95% CI: [89.990601%, 91.145641%]).
Rule 4: Both uncalibrated results (A & B) are formally identified as superseded.
Rule 5: The 90.58% calibrated result remains the sole approved design result for N_g = 220 under Section 14.7.
Rule 6: No historical result is silently deleted, conflated, or rewritten.
historical_power_provenance_reconciliati.conditionality_caveat: CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC CAVEAT: The 90.58% joint power result is strictly conditional on realizing the hypothesized population treatment profile (true disparity narrowing of -2.0 pp and superiority of -3.5 pp). If true disparity narrowing is <= -1.0 pp, simulated joint power degrades below 50%. These estimates represent design scenario targets rather than physical guarantees.

phase_2_incomplete_speaker_analysis.power_consequence_of_incomplete_clusters: CRITICAL STATISTICAL FINDING: Under Policy 2B, neither Option A (complete clusters only) nor Option B (unequal clusters) preserves the full registered N_g = 220 design across all strata. Option A results in cross-stratum speaker sample size imbalance (N_g in [215, 220], total 1,087 speakers), while Option B retains more recordings (65 accepted clips across 9 partial clusters) but introduces nine unequal-size speaker clusters (C_i in [1, 14] for 9 speakers, total 1,096 speakers). Under Option B, the statistical analysis must formally define whether speakers or recordings receive equal weighting and how the paired-cluster bootstrap handles those unequal cluster sizes (e.g. cluster-level resampling vs ratio estimation). The approved Task 6.3 joint power of 90.58% applies strictly to the balanced N_g = 220, C = 15 specification. Therefore, NEITHER OPTION CAN INHERIT THE APPROVED 90.58% POWER RESULT WITHOUT A FORMAL RE-EVALUATION. A dedicated Monte Carlo power simulation would be required to verify whether Option A or Option B maintains the one-sided 95% LCB >= 90.0% threshold.
phase_2_incomplete_speaker_analysis.reserve_replacement_nuance: OPTION C STRUCTURAL SCOPE: The provisional manifest contains 65 replacement reserve speakers for Australian English ONLY. These 65 Australian reserves may potentially replace the 2 affected Australian evaluation speakers (restoring Australian English to 220 complete speakers), strictly subject to the protocol's replacement conditions. However, the manifest contains ZERO replacement reserves for Canadian (5 affected), US (5 affected), or England (1 affected). The Australian reserves cannot replace Canadian, US, or England speakers without destroying accent stratum validity. Therefore, full cohort restoration through the reserve is structurally impossible without a formal protocol amendment and drawing from unexposed Common Voice pools.

phase_3_admission_policy_and_role_termin.dataset_admission_vs_evaluation_particip: CRITICAL GOVERNANCE DISTINCTION: Admitting all 18,975 recordings into the dataset assets (e.g. under Policy 2A) does NOT mean all 1,265 speakers participate in the confirmatory evaluation estimand. The 1,100 evaluation speakers, 100 gate-reference speakers, and 65 Australian reserve speakers strictly retain their distinct, pre-registered roles: - Evaluation Speakers (1,100): Exclusively evaluated in Primary Hypothesis Testing (Events A, B, C, D). - Gate-Reference Speakers (100): Exclusively calibrate adaptation gating; never evaluated in WER contrast estimands. - Australian Reserve Speakers (65): Standby pool for authorized dropouts; unexposed during primary confirmatory execution.
phase_3_admission_policy_and_role_termin.policy_2b_terminology_refinement: Policy 2B is formally designated an ESTIMATION_DISCREPANCY_SCREEN (or ESTIMATION_SHORTFALL_HOLD). The shortfall threshold (Delta > 1152 samples / 24-67.5 ms) represents an inherited duration-estimation discrepancy arising from non-audio container bytes. It is NOT evidence of physical bitstream corruption or upstream whole-frame truncation. The 130 recordings are held under ADMISSION_HOLD in diagnostic quarantine as an empirical discrepancy anomaly, and any scientific decision regarding their eventual admission requires separate Project Lead authorization.

policies.name: Strict Mandatory Claim B Prerequisite
policies.description: Confirmatory cohort admission strictly requires an independent, authoritative uncompressed original duration reference.
policies.consequences: Because Mozilla Common Voice 27.0 does not distribute uncompressed master WAV recordings or external duration ledgers, exactly zero recordings can satisfy Claim B. Under Policy 1, the entire cohort of 18,975 recordings must be placed on ADMISSION_HOLD. Confirmatory execution of Stage 6M Cohort 3 cannot proceed without sourcing external master references.
policies.epistemic_evaluation: Mathematically pure and conservative, but operationally halts the benchmark across all 18,975 recordings.

policies.name: Pure Claim A Physical Bitstream Admission
policies.description: Admit to confirmatory cohort under PROTOCOL_ADMIT_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED IF current-file physical MPEG frames are complete to EOF and PCM decoding succeeds without error. Treat the 130 quarantined recordings under the identical rule as the 18,845 accepted recordings.
policies.consequences: All 18,975 recordings meet the physical and decoding criteria. Exactly 18,975 recordings are admitted as dataset assets. Restores all 1,100 evaluation speakers to full 15-clip clusters. Upstream whole-frame loss is governed as a known dataset-level limitation. Gate-reference (100) and reserve (65) speakers strictly retain their non-evaluative roles.
policies.epistemic_evaluation: Uniform physical standard; requires Project Lead authorization to remediate all 130 clips.

policies.name: Decoupled Physical Validation with Estimation Discrepancy Screen
policies.description: Admit recordings that pass physical completeness AND exhibit container shortfall Delta <= 1152 samples. Hold recordings exhibiting Delta > 1152 samples under ADMISSION_HOLD in diagnostic quarantine as an empirical duration estimation discrepancy anomaly (ESTIMATION_DISCREPANCY_SCREEN / ESTIMATION_SHORTFALL_HOLD).
policies.consequences: Permits confirmatory research to proceed on the 18,845 baseline recordings whose physical bitstreams and decoded PCM are 100% complete and verified against the frozen acquisition ledger. Exactly 1,252 of 1,265 speakers (98.97%) have all 15 clips intact (1,087 evaluation, 100 gate-reference, 65 reserve). The 130 quarantined recordings (affecting 13 evaluation speakers) remain preserved in diagnostic quarantine under ADMISSION_HOLD pending separate remediation authorization (Task 7.7.4). Analysis of evaluation speakers proceeds under Option A (1,087 complete speakers) or Option B (1,096 non-empty speakers), both requiring a new power re-evaluation.
policies.epistemic_evaluation: Conservative discrepancy screen; transparently documents empirical anomaly without claiming bitstream corruption.

adversarial_validation_matrix.qualification_note: All 23 scenarios represent a proposed test matrix for future validation suites. They do NOT constitute proof that the proposed staging, atomic promotion, crash recovery, and ledger reconciliation pipeline has passed those tests, because that pipeline is currently in proposal status and has not yet been implemented.

scenarios.condition: Headerless CBR MP3 (standard Common Voice stream)
scenarios.rationale: Physical bitstream 100% complete; held pending Claim B protocol decision.

scenarios.condition: Headerless VBR MP3 (varying bitrate headers without Xing)
scenarios.rationale: Per-frame bitrates valid; held pending Claim B protocol decision.

scenarios.condition: Corrupt Xing header declared frames (declared != physical)
scenarios.rationale: Metadata anomaly isolated from physical bitstream; not marked as bitstream corrupt.

scenarios.condition: Mid-frame truncation at EOF (last frame missing bytes)
scenarios.rationale: Physical bitstream incomplete at EOF; preserved in diagnostic quarantine.

scenarios.condition: Zero-byte file (empty member in tar)
scenarios.rationale: Empty member detected at Stage 2; quarantined as FAIL_EMPTY_FILE.

scenarios.condition: Mid-stream sync-word corruption (0xFFE/0xFFF bit flip)
scenarios.rationale: Frame synchronization lost; bitstream corrupt; quarantined.

scenarios.condition: Invalid MPEG layer / sample rate / channel mode index
scenarios.rationale: Reserved/illegal header bits; non-audio payload.

scenarios.condition: Decoder agreement on clean decode (SoundFile == FFmpeg)
scenarios.rationale: Both decoders report identical samples; decodability verified.

scenarios.condition: Decoder disagreement on padding/delay (SoundFile != FFmpeg)
scenarios.rationale: Classified as inconclusive pending encoder delay investigation.

scenarios.condition: Decoded PCM all-zeros (silent audio)
scenarios.rationale: Structurally valid; flagged for scientific acoustic screening.

scenarios.condition: Stream read timeout during tar member extraction
scenarios.rationale: Partial attempt preserved in .staging/interrupted/; retried under new attempt ID.

scenarios.condition: Worker process SIGKILL during PCM decode
scenarios.rationale: Production destination untouched; journal reconciliation handles on restart.

scenarios.condition: Worker process SIGKILL during MoveFileExW promotion
scenarios.rationale: Atomic move guarantees file either exists at dest or staging; hash verifies.

scenarios.condition: Destination file already exists with identical SHA-256
scenarios.rationale: No clobber; existing file verified identical and retained.

scenarios.condition: Destination file already exists with conflicting SHA-256
scenarios.rationale: Fatal collision; conflicting file moved to collision quarantine without overwrite.

scenarios.condition: Disk space exhausted during staging write (ENOSPC)
scenarios.rationale: Pre-flight capacity check fails closed; partial writes preserved for recovery.

scenarios.condition: Torn line at EOF of wal_journal.jsonl due to crash
scenarios.rationale: Journal parser discards trailing incomplete JSON line and replays committed entries.

scenarios.condition: Process crash between atomic promotion and CSV ledger append
scenarios.rationale: Startup recovery sweep detects destination match and completes ledger record.

scenarios.condition: Concurrent worker destination collision on identical recording ID
scenarios.rationale: Second worker detects existence, verifies hash, logs idempotent pass.

scenarios.condition: Filesystem metadata flush failure (os.fsync error after destination link created)
scenarios.rationale: Destination link already exists on disk; aborting promotion cannot undo it. State transitions to DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN: retain both staging and destination without unlinking either, log to WAL, and reconcile on restart by SHA-256 match.

scenarios.condition: ID3v2 extended headers and footers present
